base.note: v89.2 (GPT-5.6-sol, 84f26d0) is byte-identical to v89.1; either is the same starting tree.

changes.scope: Security errors only. No formatting pass, no file moves, no version bump.
repairs: includes/email/class-flosc-email.php - save_newsletter_profile_field() now verifies update-user_<id> itself instead of relying on the caller having done it.

includes/flosc-personality-library.php - persona and persona_delete arrays are sanitized at the read with map_deep(); workshop_json restructured so the project sanitizer wraps the superglobal read directly.

includes/magic-link/class-flosc-magic-link-trait.php - build_guest_request_admin_redirect() takes the flow file as an argument and reads no superglobal; all 12 call sites updated to pass the value their own verified payload carried.

includes/flosc-admin.php - maybe_process_flosc_settings_post() verifies the nonce each branch's form emitted before routing, and gates on edit_others_posts (the capability the FLOSC menu itself registers).
phpcs.xml.dist - declares the two project sanitizers via customSanitizingFunctions so the sniff credits them by name.

measurements.method: PHPCS 3.13.6 + WPCS 3.4.0. Security figures are measured with every phpcs:ignore/disable directive in the tree neutered, so a suppression cannot flatter the number. Style totals use a ruleset mirroring the candidate's own phpcs.xml.dist minus PHPCompatibilityWP, which is not installed in the measuring container - so these totals are comparable between candidates but are not the same number the release gate prints.
